notes.title: Анонсирована Commandos: Origins - новая часть серии выйдет в 2024 году сразу в Xbox Game Pass
notes.notes: Издательство Kalypso Media и команда Claymore Game Studios анонсировала Commandos: Origins - новую часть в серии тактических стелс-игр в реальном времени про Вторую мировую войну.

notes.title: Commandos: Origins - A triumphant return
notes.notes:
[h1]The Commandos series returns in 2024 with Commandos: Origins[/h1]

A new story from the classic real-time stealth tactics series is now in development

We are thrilled to announce that [b]Commandos, the iconic real-time stealth tactics game series, is making a triumphant return[/b] with "Commandos: Origins" in [b]2024[/b].

[previewyoutube=XHA9IAN3ZX8;full][/previewyoutube]

Commandos: Origins takes players back to World War II, where you can [b]see the original characters unite to form the legendary Commandos squad[/b]. Engage in close-quarters-combat with The Green Beret, Jack O’Hara, and take down Nazi soldiers with brutal strength and efficiency, or obliterate key tactical targets with The Sapper, a fearless firefighter turned demolitions expert.

A gripping storyline sets the stage for a thrilling adventure, filled with challenging missions and tactical stealth gameplay. With [b]over 10 missions across authentic historical locations[/b], spanning the icy landscapes of the Arctic to the scorching sands of the African desert, you'll find yourself facing varied scenarios and diverse objectives. Each mission offers a fresh and engaging experience that keeps players eagerly anticipating each new challenge.

The game offers an exhilarating and challenging real-time strategy gameplay experience allowing you to harness the unique abilities of the Commandos, master the art of stealth, to strike from the shadows, and vanish into the night before the enemy can react.

[b]Commandos: Origins is gearing up for a 2024 release[/b] and will be available on day one on Xbox Game Pass for console and PC and on Xbox Series X|S, Windows PC, and PlayStation 5.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1479730/Commandos_Origins/

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Challenging Real Time Tactical Stealth Gameplay:[/b] Make the best use of your Commandos’ unique abilities, infiltrate enemy facilities and hit them where it hurts most before disappearing into the shadows.
[*] [b]An extraordinary team:[/b] Featuring 6 infamous characters, each with their own storied history, banding together to form an extraordinary fighting force – the Commandos: Take control over Jack O’Hara “the Green Beret”, Thomas “the Sapper” Hancock, Francis T. “the Sniper” Woolridge, Samuel “the Driver” Brooklyn, James “the Marine” Blackwood, and Rene “the Spy” Duchamp and lead them to success. 
[*][b] Many paths to victory:[/b] The detailed, varied and interactive environments offer multiple approaches to reach your goal. Sneak, climb, drive in various vehicles, or hide and creep your way to mission success!
[*] [b]On your mark:[/b] A modern user experience with precise and intuitive controls enables you to control the commandos with expert precision. Coordinate complex actions simultaneously to overcome heavily fortified targets.
[*] [b]Fight on all fronts:[/b] Play through more than 10 missions in historically authentic WWII environments, spanning from the barren Arctic to the African desert, with a range of core and voluntary objectives that will require your full tactical expertise.
[*] [b]There is no I in team:[/b] Take on missions with a friend in the 2-player cooperative multiplayer mode, either online or via local split-screen.[/list]

notes.title: Commandos 2 & 3 – HD Remaster Retail Double Pack Out Now
notes.notes:
[h1]Commandos 2 & 3 – HD Remaster Retail Double Pack Out Now[/h1]

Now in retail stores, the Commandos Double Pack offers players the chance to enjoy both HD Remasters of Commandos 2 and 3. Take history into your own hands as you lead your elite unit of Allied commandos onto the battlefields of World War II Europe. With the Green Beret, Sapper, Sniper, Diver, Spy and Thief awaiting your command, your covert actions will be of the utmost importance as you venture deep behind enemy lines. Take on more than 20 perilous missions across the two cult classics where your tactics will be put to the ultimate test. Experiment with daring strategy, employ authentic weaponry and utilise interactive environments as you crawl, swing, swim and climb to victory. Mission accepted?  

Time to rally your recruits for the Commandos 2 & 3 HD Double Pack which is now available in stores on Xbox One, PlayStation 4, [b]PC (Steam at Retail)[/b] and Nintendo Switch™ (Retail version only available on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in North America).  

Fall in and ambush the trailer below. 
https://youtu.be/voAPrCXWb4E

[h2]Features [/h2]
[list][*] Control unique daredevil commandos: each with different skills and specializations including green beret, sniper, demolition expert, diver and thief. 
[*] Experience authentic WWII scenarios: there are more than 20 missions across the two games!  
[*] The choice is yours: how you tackle each mission is up to you. Experiment with skills and weapons in a challenging “against the odds” gameplay style. 
[*] WWII vehicles and weapons: including jeeps, tanks, trucks, ships, bazookas and flame-throwers.  
[*] Interactive environments: steal enemy uniforms and weapons, climb poles, swing from cables, swim, utilize vehicles, and climb in/out of buildings, ships and planes. 
[*] Remastered in high definition: includes reworked 3D models and textures built from the ground up, improved controls, refined UI and beginner-friendly tutorials and hints. 
[*] Rally your troops for multiplayer in Commandos 3 – HD Remaster: you can compete in ‘Deathmatch’ or ‘Collect the Flag’ modes, all with distinct victory conditions. 
[/list]

notes.title: New Update (v1.12) for Commandos 2 - HD Remaster has been released!
notes.notes:
Commandos,

Thanks again for your feedback thus far. 

We’ve been hard at work improving the game and we’re happy to announce today’s update v.1.12 - which includes community requests such as additional save slots, as well as many more bug fixes.

For a more comprehensive update list, check out the changelog below:

[h3]Improvements and additions[/h3]

[list][*] Increased save slots to 20 and quick save slots to 3
[*] Added gamepad functionality[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

[list][*] Fixed: Bonus Diary fails to appear on screen or gets stuck when spamming mouse buttons
[*] Fixed: slow loading time when loading a saved game from the pause menu
[*] Fixed: some enemies wouldn’t highlight when player pressed F11
[*] Fixed: black background would display when player entered the second level of the Eiffel Tower
[*] Fixed: incorrect items would display when player looked through the notebook
[*] Fixed: random objectives or item descriptions could not be closed using the right mouse button or ‘Esc’
[*] Fixed: incorrect mouse cursor offset on top of the Eiffel Tower
[*] Fixed: Spanish placeholder text was displayed in some areas
[*] Fixed: upon entering a vehicle, camera UI fails would fail to display
[*] Fixed: infinite loading screen during ‘The Giant in Haiphong’ mission
[*] Fixed: small amount of graphical artifacting at maximum zoom
[*] Fixed: graphical artifacts in Picture-In-Picture window
[*] Fixed: Private Smith wouldn’t walk to the radio in the mission ‘Saving Private Smith’
[*] Fixed: multiple inventory stacking issues
[*] Fixed: characters and animals weren’t visible on the water’s surface
[*] Fixed: some objectives wouldn’t mark as completed even after player met the required conditions
[*] Fixed: placement of mouse cursor shifted slightly at low resolutions
[*] Fixed: enemy vision cones and markers would not display correctly on water’s surface
[*] Fixed: Green Beret is not shown as having been buried after player loads a saved game
[*] Fixed: yellow marker missing from Eiffel Tower interior during 'Is Paris Burning?' mission
[*] Fixed: character model overlaps vehicle model when sitting on side seat or behind driver
[*] Fixed: sniper rifle crosshairs do not move when aiming at an enemy
[*] Fixed: Low-resolution textures in some areas of the submarine during the mission ‘White Death’
[*] Fixed: Camera control moved to F8 instead of F12 to avoid interference with Steam functionalities
[*] Fixed: tripwire displayed as pixelated after loading a saved game
[*] Fixed: some mines would only partially display in the mission ‘Saving Private Smith’
[*] Fixed: some enemies were invisible while shooting from inside and through a window
[*] Fixed: some random inventory freezes when swapping ammunition between player character and stunned soldiers
[*] Fixed: some animations for animals were incorrectly displayed
[*] Made some general improvements to gameplay and visuals (particularly masking)
[*] Minor bug fixes and polishing[/list]


[h3]Commandos 2 HD Remaster Known Issues (v.1.12)[/h3]
The issues below are known and currently being worked on. These will be fixed in future updates.

[h3]Graphics:[/h3]
[list][*] Some sporadic graphical glitches
[*] Some vehicles, such as trains, have minor animations missing such as rotating wheels
[*] General performance has been improved and optimization is ongoing
[*] Picture-in-Picture mode still has some artifacting and missing asset issues to be resolved e.g. doors, character shadows
[*] Should you experience screen flicker, please set your game resolution to the native screen resolution of your monitor. If you cannot do this, set the game to windowed mode, then change the resolution settings to match your monitor’s native resolution.[/list]
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list][*] When experiencing problems with saved games or missions being skipped, please check that your saved game folder isn’t located on an external hard drive but an internal one[/list]
[h3]Original game related bugs or changes:[/h3]
[list][*] Highlighted ladders, windows and doors don’t always align correctly[/list]

notes.title: Commandos 2 HD Remaster review
notes.notes:
Developer: Pyro Studios, Yippee! Entertainment
Publisher: Kalypso
Release: Out now
On: Windows
From: Steam, GOG
Price: 17

When you send your Renoir nude off to the restorer for a spruce-up there’s no danger it will return with the nipples painted out because the restorer thought they might cause offence or arousal. Things work a little differently with computer games it seems. Much-loved isometric sneak-em-up Commandos 2 has come back from refurbishment missing a few aesthetic details. German flags have shed their swastikas, Hinomarus have disappeared from the wings and fuselages of Japanese aircraft, and footage of vile misery-monger Adolf Hitler has been cut from the intro cinematic. The edits plus a host of bugs and shortcomings explain the game’s less than rapturous reception and the waspish words about to waft from my word piano. (more…)

notes.title: Commandos 2 HD Remaster is due a patch fixing bugs and poor performance
notes.notes:
A fancied-up rerelease of a venerated WW2 squad tactics game sounds grand but the reality of Commands 2 HD Remaster is less splendid. Following its launch on Friday, many players have complained about bugs and poor performance – a surprising problem considering it doesn’t look wildly different to its original incarnation 19 years ago. The makers responded over the weekend, saying ah, yeah, whoops, we’ll try to do something about all this. They’re working on a patch, though don’t say when we should expect it.

(more…)

notes.title: Kalypso have set up a new Commandos game studio
notes.notes:
Kalypso Media have set up an internal studio to make a new Commandos game with the rights they bought last year. This is good news.

My two year-old brain hadn’t developed to the point where it could enjoy sneaky shooting in Commandos: Behind Enemy Lines back in ’98, or in any of its sequels, but my brain’s more advanced form did adore Shadow Tactics: Blades Of The Shogun. Tim Stone lavished his Shadow Tactics review with Commandos 2 comparisons, so I’m hoping this will be up my street.

(more…)

notes.title: Commandos 2, Praetorians HD remasters get January release date on PC
notes.notes:
Kalypso Media has revealed that its HD remasters of stealth-tactics classic Commandos 2 and Roman Empire strategy game Praetorians will be coming to PC on 24th January next year.

Commandos 2, which was developed by Pyro Studios and originally debuted in 2001, tasks players with leading a small team of WW2 soldiers - each with their own unique specialisations, ranging from sniper to demolitions expert - across a series of isometric stages in order to complete various open-ended sabotage and assassination missions.

Its brutally challenging blend of strategy and stealth earned it much praise (and elicited many swears, I can attest) on release, and Kalypso Media's HD remaster promises to build on the original with updated graphics and enhanced controls.

Read more

notes.title: Commandos 2 and Praetorians HD Remasters coming in January
notes.notes:
A double-bill of revamped Pyro Studios games are coming our way on January 24th, 2020, publishers Kalypso announced today: “HD Remasters” of Commandos 2 and Praetorians. 2001’s Commandos 2 is a proper good’un, a squad-based tactical isometric sneak-o-shooter about covert operations in World War 2 – and a huge inspiration for newer games like Shadow Tactics. Praetorians is a Roman RTS, which I don’t know but I bet Ghoastus does. The HD Remasters look worse to my eye and the originals are still sold so I’m not wholly sure what the point is, but hey, any excuse to remind people of Commandos?

(more…)
